description: This vertical bar chart illustrates the average number of likes across five sequential numerical intervals. The horizontal axis represents the categories, which are labeled as "(0,90]", "(90,180]", "(180,270]", "(270,360]", and "(360,450]", ordered sequentially from left to right with the text rotated diagonally. A blurred, unreadable label is positioned below the category labels. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Avg. Like #", using a linear scale that begins at 400 and extends to 600, with tick marks at regular intervals of 50. The chart features five individual bars, all colored light blue with thin black outlines, and each includes a vertical black error bar centered at the top. The bars vary slightly in height; the tallest bar corresponds to the "(0,90]" category with an approximate value of 600, while the shortest bar is for the "(90,180]" category at approximately 565. The remaining bars for "(180,270]", "(270,360]", and "(360,450]" have approximate values of 570, 595, and 590, respectively. The bars are sorted by their defined numerical intervals rather than by height, and no single bar is visually emphasized beyond the standard formatting.
